subject: All draft edges
needed_evidence: Dated usable throughput by direction, commodity and bottleneck, with ton definition and operating hours.
ruling: [I] Demand, handled traffic, frequent car-count lower bounds, nominal stock and annual revenue cannot establish rated maximum capacity.

subject: All draft edges
needed_evidence: Dated loaded journeys, schedules or actual departure/arrival records.
ruling: [I] Route miles and an eighty-mile round wagon detour do not determine graph days.

subject: Rail baseline and seven gauge-transfer candidates
needed_evidence: Company-specific effective gauge dates, siding connections, handling arrangements and car interchange.
ruling: [I] Directory publication is no effective date; military conversion must supersede earlier incompatibility on the converted section.

subject: Alexandria Loudoun and Hampshire; Atlantic and North Carolina
needed_evidence: Dated company records resolving projected and completed route extent, including printed endpoint/mileage descriptions.
ruling: [I] Hold projected or questionable directory extents; do not repair historical geography or complete track by assumption.

subject: B&O fiscal 1862 report
needed_evidence: Resolve title/fiscal 1862 versus transportation header printed October 1 1864.
ruling: [I] Preserve both dates; do not silently emend 1864 or certify actual composition date.

subject: Tennessee and Cumberland low water
needed_evidence: Reach-specific dated gauges, vessel drafts and loads, transshipment and last actual passage.
ruling: [I] Sixteen-inch vessel draft is not channel depth; one boat load or witness closure description is no universal seasonal rule.

subject: Mississippi continuity
needed_evidence: Date-specific controlled reaches and lawful safe passage for each side.
ruling: [I] Do not open a Union through route past Vicksburg from Memphis/Helena transport or a proposed Yazoo operation.

subject: All depots
needed_evidence: Dated opening and closing inventories, receipts, issues, losses and commodity definitions.
ruling: [I] A reserve reported for some time, an order, promise or requisition does not fill daily stock or storage capacity.

subject: Quartermaster purchases at principal depots
needed_evidence: Delivery, serviceability and allocation records after purchase.
ruling: [I] July-September purchase counts are not September 30 inventories or active transport teams; totals overlap local rows.

subject: Confederate Nashville evacuation
needed_evidence: Shaaff returns or other dated primary balances resolving stores actually present and removed.
ruling: [I] Preserve Northrops explicit inability to state total and Forrests wagon-load range; no pounds per wagon inferred.

subject: Thoroughfare pork withdrawal account
needed_evidence: Original account or clarification of printed one-pound discrepancies.
ruling: [I] Preserve each printed figure; no silent reconciliation, no counting promises or seven unmoved cars as delivered.

subject: Fort Pillow small-arms reserve
needed_evidence: Original report or explanatory return for 149000 total versus 141500 named components.
ruling: [I] Keep 7500 unexplained; do not allocate missing cartridges or replace printed total.

subject: Local corn and civilian acquisition
needed_evidence: Gate review of sourcing, agency, civilian loss, coercion and appropriate placement before mechanical use.
ruling: [I] No automatic free local supply, loyalty modifier or labour/freight abstraction for protected people.

subject: Nine principal clothing depots
needed_evidence: Separate local inventories and dated issues.
ruling: [I] Do not divide the national suit/cloth aggregate among nine places or treat June stock as recurring output.

subject: December changes and later military totals
needed_evidence: Sources for any proposed extension beyond November 30 1862.
ruling: [I] February 1863 Aquia wharf depths and July 1862-June 1863 traffic totals are excluded; future Yazoo intentions are not completed movements.
